findings.issue: User password may be persisted in flutter_secure_storage when remember-me is enabled
findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker with unlocked device or backup extraction reads remembered password
findings.recommendation: Store email only; use biometric re-auth or token refresh instead of password persistence
findings.evidence: rememberedPassword key defined and used in login flow

findings.issue: No global HTTP throttle middleware on API route group
findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker floods authenticated or public endpoints causing DoS or cost amplification on signed URL generation
findings.impact: Service degradation, Bunny token generation abuse
findings.recommendation: Add RouteServiceProvider rate limiters per route group; stricter limits on playback/download
findings.evidence: Only LoginThrottleService and OTP services implement custom limits
findings.phase2_evidence: api-guest + api-authenticated baseline; 14 named endpoint limiters in AppServiceProvider; ApiRateLimitTest

findings.issue: No dedicated automated regression test for cross-student annotation IDOR
findings.exploit_scenario: Student changes fileId to another enrolled/unenrolled file and writes annotations
findings.impact: Data tampering or info leak depending on policy gap
findings.recommendation: Add tests/Feature/Security/Authorization/AnnotationIdorTest.php

findings.issue: No automated authorization regression test for quiz IDOR
findings.exploit_scenario: Student submits answers for quiz in unsubscribed course
findings.impact: Grade manipulation or business logic bypass
findings.recommendation: Add Security quiz authorization tests

findings.issue: Model builds public Storage::url fallback for file_url field
findings.exploit_scenario: Future API resource accidentally serializes accessor exposing local public URL
findings.impact: Protected PDF served from public disk if misconfigured
findings.recommendation: Remove public URL accessor from default serialization; use signed download service only
findings.evidence: Storage::disk('public')->url pattern; LessonFileStorageAuditTest covers audit path
findings.phase2_evidence: LessonFile::resolvedFileUrl returns null; LessonFileSerializationTest; API never exposes permanent URLs

findings.issue: 3 Laravel advisories ignored in composer.json — require documented exceptions
findings.exploit_scenario: Unreviewed ignore hides supply-chain risk
findings.recommendation: advisory-exceptions.yaml + CI validation; patch when non-breaking

findings.issue: PDF bytes cached unencrypted in app documents directory
findings.exploit_scenario: Physical access or backup extracts cached paid PDF
findings.recommendation: Evaluate encrypted cache or clear on logout; document residual risk
findings.phase2_evidence: User-scoped app-private pdf_cache/{userId}; logout/account-switch clear; V1 no encryption-at-rest documented; pdf_cache_security_test.dart

findings.issue: Manual screenshots not preventable on iOS (platform limitation)
findings.exploit_scenario: User screenshots paid content despite screen protection
findings.recommendation: Maintain recording overlay; optional screenshot notice

findings.issue: No automated test for revoking another user's device ID
findings.exploit_scenario: IDOR on device ID forces logout of another session
findings.recommendation: Add device ownership test

findings.issue: Cross-user notification IDOR not covered by automated test
findings.exploit_scenario: Iterate notification IDs to mark/read others' notifications
findings.recommendation: Policy scope test

findings.issue: Placeholder test fails (expects 200 on /, gets 302 redirect)
findings.exploit_scenario: N/A — blocks CI quality gate
findings.recommendation: Update or remove ExampleTest; assert redirect to /admin

findings.issue: Smoke test expects 'RSHD' text not in current UI
findings.exploit_scenario: N/A — blocks flutter test gate

findings.issue: Filament resource authorization not covered by automated API-style security suite
findings.exploit_scenario: Instructor accesses another instructor's subject via Filament URL manipulation
findings.recommendation: Filament policy tests + HasInstructorScope audit
findings.phase2_evidence: FilamentInstructorScopeTest (query scope + student redirect); full bulk-action suite deferred

findings.issue: Video sync/refresh errors logged via debugPrint may include API messages
findings.exploit_scenario: Debug build logs leak URL fragments on shared device logs
findings.recommendation: Redact URLs in debug logs; kDebugMode guards
findings.phase2_evidence: SensitiveDataRedactor (Flutter + PHP SafeLogger); kDebugMode-only network error logs redacted

findings.issue: Semgrep not installed in local dev environment
findings.exploit_scenario: N/A

findings.issue: No test for absurd progress values (negative, > duration flood)
findings.exploit_scenario: Spam progress updates or corrupt analytics
findings.recommendation: Validate bounds; rate limit per video

findings.issue: No dedicated security regression test for registration abuse
